column1: # emulatr_env_registry.tsv -- curated EMULATR_* runtime variable registry
# Project: EmulatR -- EmulatrLaunch (SPEC-LAUNCH-001 Rev D.2)
# Version: 1.0.0-alpha   Date: 2026-07-29
# Spec:    Section 7.1 (V1/V2) -- the ONLY source of rows for the W6 panel.
# Section 13 G2b requires an EVIDENCE CENSUS of every runtime getenv
# ("EMULATR_*") in the core tree, with file/line anchors, value kind, effect,
# and TIM'S SIGN-OFF ON THE TIERING, before rows appear here.  The panel
# renders ONLY census output (V1), so this file ships nearly empty BY DESIGN.
# It is not a stub to be filled in by guesswork -- classifying a diagnostic
# knob as "safe" without evidence is exactly the failure G2b exists to prevent.
# Census scale (measured 2026-07-29, informational only, NOT a classification):
#   ~140 getenv("EMULATR_*") call sites across coreLib, chipsetLib, deviceLib,
#   pipelineLib, mmuLib, memoryLib, palBoxLib, systemLib, traceLib, main.cpp.
# The ONE row below is not census output either -- it is transcribed from the
# spec itself, which names EMULATR_RSCCWARP as the founding denied-tier member
# (Section 7.1 V2, "confirmed boot corruption").  Shipping it now means the
# denylist STRIPPING PATH is live and testable from day one.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   name         the environment variable, verbatim
#   kind         flag | path | integer | enum        (flag hides the value cell)
#   default      default value; empty for flag rows
#   description  one line, tester-readable
#   tier         safe | dev | denied                 (V2)
#   anchor       core-tree evidence, file:line of the getenv
# tier semantics (V2):
#   safe    visible to everyone
#   dev     behind "Show developer variables", default off
#   denied  never displayed, never settable, and STRIPPED from the child
#           environment even when present in the launcher's own inherited
#           environment.  Quarantining is a data change, not a code change.
# name
